items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I played one summer with him as well

ctx.x: Yes. We did a couple of armories-that somebody else had that idea. But, our manager said, why don't --- we got the idea; there's more armories; we can rent them very cheap. And, as kids, we were just doing crazy, you know, doing very well And, uh, first my home town had other

bands; they had--- we had a clown band in that town which was they dressed up in clown suits but they only played things like fairs and things like that, but there was another guy there that had a band; his name was James Jackson and he was a doctor's son and he played the drums and, uh, he was a damn good drummer and I played one summer with him as well.
